_comment: Cost-ledger budget (features/cost-ledger). REPO DEFAULTS, not amounts the user agreed to — the user changes them with POST /api/cost/budget, with `python3 cost_ledger.py --set-budget`, or by editing this file (synced to the machine as working/cost-budget.json) and restarting. Either cap binds: the day stops when EITHER the token cap OR the USD cap is reached. Set a cap to null to disable that cap (not recommended for both at once).
_why_200000: About 2.5x the observed 2026-11-14 day (~73,000 tokens, see features/approvals/README.md). Agentic loops resend full context every turn, so a busy day can reach this honestly — the 80% alert is the warning to raise it, not proof of a runaway.
